# Authorized Claude Fable review

Review the exact renewal correction in /home/yan/src/quod_worktrees/pearl-stone. Read that worktree's AGENTS.md, the complete applicable Stage2 plan, doc/spaces.md and doc/multiwrite-architecture.md. This is a read-only consultative code review. Do not edit files, run commands, builds or tests, start hardware, alter deadlines, commit or publish. Do not claim runtime evidence beyond the existing receipts.

Exact patch: doc/evidence/stage2-renewal-diagnosis-20261103/proposal03/correction.patch. It is now installed byte-for-byte in the worktree; the Erlog source also matches the already attached dependency checkout. Application hashes: doc/evidence/stage2-renewal-delivery-20261103/application01.json and attached-erlog01.json. Immutable prior freeze: nimbalyst-local/review-packets/stage2-renewal-diagnosis01/manifest.json and result.json. Read the campaign STATUS.md and proposal03/README.md for applied-versus-isolated evidence and literal failures.

Check: (1) inductive native failure-stack validity and retention/order/truncation behavior; explicit whole-stack callback policies and finite tests must remain unchanged; (2) equivalence of removing the default Quod callback to current native portable validation, retaining real wire admission; (3) whether checkpoint_depth0 can ever retain live distributed tokens under any real savepoint, scope, cut, error, restore or reentrant lifecycle; (4) coverage and provenance of338 tests, the original three-renewal/one30-second signed acceptance and its real update/revocation/stale denial/reconnect/unchanged-work checks; (5) commit coherence with the already uncommitted prerequisite refactor and current dependency pin.

Current isolated acceptance renewals:7.993/8.035/8.003s;29 signed checks;server/client0/0/all4EOF. Normal production compilation verified. Earlier failures remain literal. Proposal02's completion hypothesis is abandoned, not part of this correction. No source policy bypass/cache/new domain path/new limit is allowed. Actual correction production delta+16/−10; scope must not absorb unrelated user-owned Godot/hardware work or private archives.

Return one consolidated report with prioritized concrete findings and exact source references, explicit applied-versus-tested distinction, limitations and a clear commit-readiness verdict. If no blocking defect is found, state that; do not invent mandatory review rounds. Treat the parent review as context, not a substitute for your own inspection.
